views.text: In July 2025, Equity Mates noted revenue climbed from 1.9 billion to 9.2 billion over four years, losses narrowed from 600 million to 270 million before a 25 million profit, and said bulls also cited its CEO’s prior Aetna tenure where the share price rose sevenfold from 2010 to 2018.
